# .github/public-exclude.txt
# Authoritative blacklist for the public repo snapshot.
# Used by the git archive workflow in docs/guides/two-remote-sync.md.
# Paths relative to repo root. Applied: rm -rf /tmp/release/$pattern
# NOTE: glob patterns need a separate rm -f step (see workflow).

.claude/skills/sd-brand-guidelines
.claude/skills/linkedin-carousel

.claude/skills/linkedin-shared

# Personal skill — hook formulas/examples reference the owner's own posts
# and voice; not generic template content.
.claude/skills/linkedin-hook

# Brand-specific commands
.claude/commands/demo.md

# Personal-document skill — eval fixtures contain real personal data
# (names, national ID numbers, a street address). Never publish.
.claude/skills/formal-doc
.claude/skills/formal-doc-workspace

# Individual FEAT-* directories — clean slate for public users
# NOTE: docs/features/README.md is intentionally kept (not matched by this glob)
# Glob expansion requires unquoted rm in step 4 of the sync workflow
docs/features/FEAT-*

# Private research, guides, and working docs
docs/research
docs/guides/creating-branded-presentations.md
docs/z-alba

# PPTX HTML build sources (compiled .pptx stays; raw HTML sources are internal)
docs/system/pptx-workspace

# Personal workspace files (committed before .gitignore entry was added)
workspace

# Runtime files — gitignored but listed as safety backstop
.claude/logs/agent.db
.claude/logs/security.log
.claude/session-state.json
.claude/settings.local.json
.claude/_archive
.claude/logs/agent.db.bak
.claude/settings.json.bak

# Release-gate data files — the pattern file enumerates the very personal
# tokens it protects (names, brands, domains); never ship it. The gate
# script itself (scripts/public_release_gate.sh) is generic and does ship.
.github/pii-patterns.txt
.github/release-waivers.txt

# Internal-only v2 observability schema tests — they test the v2 send_event/
# init_db additions that public-overrides deliberately replaces with v1;
# shipping them makes the public suite fail by construction.
test/unit/FEAT-035/test_observability_schema.py

# Debug session records — real project/client context accumulates here
docs/debug

# Internal feature roadmap — public repo ships an empty features placeholder
docs/features/backlog.md
